items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Eric, you know Eric and Mingus and Ornette you know those are our folks.

ctx.x: Yeah he had a sense of humor as well. He was a nice man, really really good man and a great musician.
Well you know I’m from California, we’re (Ken and I) from California so Eric, you know Eric and Mingus and Ornette you know those are our folks. You got Philadelphia, that’s all we got is California.
